summary: Jokoo Partners (ambassadors) Phase 2 audit — backend-only. Created new test suite /app/backend/tests/test_ambassadors_p2.py covering all NEW/refactored features from the audit: 35/35 P2 tests PASS. Also updated /app/backend/tests/test_ambassadors_p1.py (3 tests) to align with spec changes (list format `{total, items}`, self-attach returning explicit 400, rate-limit constant 200). Full ambassadors suite = 64 passed + 1 skipped (0 failures). All 6 requirement blocks from review request verified: (1) admin config CRUD + list new format + search q + active filter + pagination + new single GET/PUT, (2) user self endpoints incl. `?status=` referrals filter, (3) public endpoints (leaderboard shape + resolve + /public/invite/{code}), (4) end-to-end referral hook (register creates pending referral), (5) security guards (401/403/400 self-referral/404 invalid code), (6) edge cases (partial thresholds → defaults, invalid commission status → 400, slug accents normalized to 'aida-test', slug already taken → 400, route ordering /config not shadowed by /{uid}). MAX_ATTACH_PER_IP_PER_DAY correctly = 200.
action_items: OK: module Jokoo Partners is production-ready from a backend perspective. Route ordering bug fix confirmed (config/commissions routes reachable before /{uid} regex catch-all).

OPTIONAL — /admin/ambassadors/{uid} returns the ambassador object directly (not wrapped in {ambassador: ...}); PUT variant returns {ok, ambassador}. Consider harmonizing both shapes to always wrap in {ok, ambassador} for consistency (currently the frontend has to handle 2 shapes).
OPTIONAL — /ambassadors/me/referrals accepts ?status=<value> but silently ignores invalid values (returns unfiltered). Consider returning 400 on invalid status to help debug frontend bugs.
critical_code_review_comments: ambassadors.py (1157 lines) is getting close to 700-line soft-limit. Consider splitting into ambassadors/router.py + ambassadors/hooks.py + ambassadors/config.py to keep responsibilities focused.

Route ordering: literal paths /admin/ambassadors/config and /admin/ambassadors/commissions ARE now correctly declared BEFORE /admin/ambassadors/{uid} (lines 775, 795, 818, 841). Verified via test_config_route_reachable & test_commissions_route_reachable.
Slug normalization via _slugify() strips accents (unicode NFD) and non-alphanum — verified 'Aïdà-Tést' → 'aida-test'.
Slug uniqueness enforced via unique sparse index + explicit conflict check in POST/PUT handlers (400 on collision).

Config merge: `get_config()` correctly merges DB values on top of DEFAULT_TIER_THRESHOLDS + DEFAULT_TIER_COMMISSIONS, so partial updates (bronze only) keep diamond=150 elite=500 as defaults. Verified.
Auth guards: /admin/* → 401 without token / 403 with client token; /ambassadors/me* → 401 without token / 403 for non-ambassador. All paths verified.
Self-referral: /ambassadors/attach now returns 400 explicit ('Vous ne pouvez pas être votre propre parrain') instead of silent no-op — good UX improvement.
Rate-limit: MAX_ATTACH_PER_IP_PER_DAY raised from 20 → 200 (aligned with review request; skip_ip_check=True for authenticated attach).
PII stripped from /me/referrals response (ip_hash / email_hash / phone_hash excluded via projection).
No MongoDB _id leaks in any of the 20+ endpoints tested.
